summary: The comment expresses opposition to proposals to limit or sunset the E-Rate program, emphasizing the essential role of E-Rate funding in providing broadband infrastructure for schools and libraries. The comment cites specific funding amounts received by the East St. Louis School District 189 over the past five years to illustrate the impact of E-Rate support. The school district emphasizes the importance of preserving the E-Rate program to ensure access to reliable and affordable internet connectivity for schools and libraries. They argue that the program is essential for bridging differences in local wealth and technological capacity and supports various critical needs of the school system. The school district urges policymakers to preserve the E-Rate program and oppose changes that would reduce, limit, or sunset its support for schools and librarie The East St. Louis School District 189 emphasizes the importance of preserving E-Rate funding, stating that it is essential infrastructure for schools and not tied to screen-time policies. The district highlights the cost implications of not having E-Rate support and the need to address screen-time concerns separately from connectivity funding. The district requests to oppose changes that would substantially reduce, limit, or sunset
